submitted_curve.commentary:
This curve was found as a rational specialization, at parameter \(t=3/17\), of an elliptic-curve family of generic rank 16.

We found 22 independent rational points on the specialized curve, proving that its Mordell–Weil rank over \(\mathbb{Q}\) is at least 22. The exact rank is not currently known.

The submitted equation is a global minimal Weierstrass model. Its conductor was computed and independently certified to be

5651319165610115296564894984823807468501395910978185811787187868498410205790.

The factorization and local reduction data used in the conductor calculation, as well as exact certificates for the 22 independent points, are available in the accompanying research repository.
